subject: Sterile-site deploy check-in & signer escalation
messages:
From: Amit Rao <amit.rao@acme-industries.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Holt <samantha.holt@acme-industries.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial runbook review for isolated site deployment

David / Marissa —

Thanks for the call earlier. Attaching Acme's local acceptance checklist and the delivery window constraints for our Sterling facility. Two quick asks before we lock dates:

- Can Redwood confirm the signer roster (who will countersign at handoff) and the expected on-prem operator role required for activation?
- We require MD5 and signed manifest for the bundle delivered to the sealed room (we'll verify on arrival).

We can accept courier delivery between Aug 28–30 (08:00–12:00 local time) but need the on-site operator to be present +2 hrs after arrival for validation and smoke tests.

Attachments: delivery-instructions-courier.pdf (2 pages), acme-sterile-acceptance.xlsx (sheet)

Cheers,
Amit Rao
Head of Ops, Acme Industries
mobile: +1 415-555-0187

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Amit Rao <amit.rao@acme-industries.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial runbook review for isolated site deployment

Amit —

Thanks, received. Quick confirmation items from our side:

1) Signer roster: Primary signer for the bundle will be Marissa Cole (Redwood SRE lead). Secondary countersign will be Karthik Iyer (field ops). Both will be listed on the signed manifest; we'll include key fingerprints and signing timestamps.

2) On-site operator role: Acme needs to provide an "Operator-Activation" user (local account) that will perform bundle import and run activation script. We'll provide the operator-handbook (attached) for exact commands and the verification checklist.

3) Bundle format: We'll ship signed-manifest-v3.tar.gz with 1) manifest.json (signed, detached), 2) signed image blobs, 3) operator scripts. We'll include MD5 and SHA256 checksums in the manifest.

Can we schedule a 30m dry-run next Tuesday (Aug 25) to walk through the checksum verification and the acceptance prompts? Please confirm availability for Amit or Samantha.

Attachments: operator-handbook-sterile-v1.4.pdf

—
David Kim
Director, Private Deployments, Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Holt <samantha.holt@acme-industries.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial runbook review for isolated site deployment

Thanks David — Aug 25 dry-run works for us at 10:00 PT.

One operational note: our facility security requires that any countersigners be present in person for the handoff if the bundle is arriving on physical media. Marissa, can you confirm whether the secondary signer (Karthik) will attend the courier handoff or whether countersign will happen remotely (we have stricter rules for remote countersigning).

Also: what is Redwood's fallback plan if the checksum verification fails on-site? We've had bad experiences where the courier delivered a corrupted tarball and it caused a 24hr outage while replacements were prepared.

—
Samantha Holt
Program Manager, Sterling Deployments
Acme Industries
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Holt <samantha.holt@acme-industries.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial runbook review for isolated site deployment

Samantha —

We do prefer in-person countersign for media handoffs; Karthik confirmed he can be on-site for the courier window (Aug 28 morning) and will perform the physical signature. If that's not possible for any reason we will only accept countersign via an HSM-backed remote signing gateway — which Acme would need to whitelist in advance.

Fallback plan for corruption:
- Stage 0: Local verification (MD5/SHA256) — if mismatch, bundle marked corrupt and sealed.
- Stage 1: If corruption detected, operator runs the recovery script which attempts to re-download a signed delta from Redwood's locked replication bundle (if network egress allowed).
- Stage 2: If network egress is not permitted (true air-gapped), Redwood will dispatch a sealed replacement media on the next courier slot (we hold a hot spare copy in secure escrow).

Estimate timing: with a hot spare we can target replacement delivery within 24 hours of confirmed corruption; without a hot spare, lead time depends on courier and customs (48+ hours). We will document all timelines in the rollout playbook.

I'll attach a short appendix that enumerates signer fingerprints and the hot-spare policy.

—
Marissa Cole
SRE Lead, Private Deployments, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: signer-roster-appendix.txt]

Samantha / Amit —

We confirm pickup from Redwood's secure locker scheduled for Aug 28 05:30 PT, ETA Sterling facility Aug 28 09:20 local. Driver will request sign-in at Gate B and will not open sealed package in public areas. We will hold the manifest copy in tamper-evident pouch and will provide chain-of-custody photo at handoff.

Please ensure the on-site operator meets driver at Gate B with government ID. Any deviation requires pre-authorization.

Stubs attached: delivery-log-template.csv

—
Courier Express Ops

Subject: Re: Sterile-site deploy check-in & signer escalation

Samantha —

I'll be on-site for the handoff and will perform countersign as agreed. A couple of operational notes for the dry-run on Aug 25: please provision a test account on the operator VLAN that allows only checksum verification and bundle import (no outbound network). We'll exercise the recovery script in air-gapped mode so you see the expected failure modes.

On the replacement media: Marissa and I have confirmed Redwood's hot-spare exists in the regional escrow locker (encrypted, sealed). If corruption is found we will coordinate with Courier Express to prioritize a same-day reissue. I'll also bring a USB-based recovery kit (encrypted) if permitted by Sterling facility policy.

See you on the 25th at 10:00 PT.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Field Ops — Private Deployments, Redwood Inference
